_note: Generated by scripts/build_papers.py. One row per current manuscript: whether the atlas shows an HTML reading view of it, and the counts behind that status. Do not edit by hand.

checker.name: KaTeX
checker.note: The check runs the KaTeX version the site loads.

gate.accepted: every formula checked and typeset; every cross-reference and citation resolved; every environment and command understood; every extracted statement anchored. Figures may be placeholders.
gate.partial: a page is written with a banner listing what failed and linking the PDF
gate.unavailable: no page; the PDF is the only route
gate.statement_anchor: papers/<slug>.html#<label> for a labelled statement; every theorem-like block also carries the id L-<file>-<line>, the location of its \begin in data/manuscripts.json
